items.label: Farmhouse Style TV stand
items.value: This media console cabinet can be used as a TV stand to support flat screen TVs up to 65", suitable for most home TV placement. If you like, it can also serve as a storage cabinet to show your family photos and potted plants.

items.label: Sliding Barn Doors
items.value: Two movable barn doors on the TV stand for convenient access to cabinets. Quality steel bar make doors slide smoothly, and no noise during movement. Two sliding barn door design to conceal side storage cabinets or center storage shelves.

items.label: Sturdy and Sturdy Structure
items.value: Made from high-grade certified manufactured wood frame. Made of high quality decorative laminate, the top board has good toughness and is difficult to deform. Feel assured to place your TV on this TV stand and enjoy your leisure time.

items.label: Sufficient Storage Space
items.value: This TV stand console comes with 2 cabinets of storage space and 2 open spaces in the barn doors on both sides with 3 levels of adjustable and removable shelves, providing abundant storage or display space for CDs, DVDs, game boxes, decorative items and more. The spacious tabletop supports 40, 43, 50, 55, 60, and 65 inch TV.

items.label: Relieved by Easy Assembly
items.value: This TV console table comes with numbered parts and clear instructions, you can quickly install the TV stand in little time. If you are in contact with the TV cabinet for the first time, it is recommended that two people assemble it correctly.
